description: This header file defines the 'CommonEncryptionData' class within the WPEFramework::Plugin namespace. The class handles parsing and managing common encryption data, including processing PSSH boxes, XML, and JSON data related to digital rights management (DRM) systems like PlayReady, WideVine, ClearKey, and others. It provides interfaces for adding, updating, and querying encryption key IDs and their statuses.

classes.name: CommonEncryptionData
classes.description: A class for parsing and managing DRM encryption data, including PSSH boxes, XML, and JSON init data. It maintains a list of 'KeyId's and provides methods to parse and add keys, check key support, and handle key statuses.

classes.name: CommonEncryptionData::KeyId
classes.description: A nested class representing a key identifier with associated system types, inheriting from OCDM::KeyId. It encapsulates key data and system flags.

methods.name: CommonEncryptionData
methods.description: Constructor initializing the object with raw encryption data, parsing the data for keys and system info.

methods.name: Status
methods.description: Returns the status of the first key ID, or pending if no keys are present.

methods.name: Status(const KeyId& key)
methods.description: Returns the status of a specific key ID.

methods.name: Keys
methods.description: Returns an iterator over the list of key IDs.

methods.name: HasKeyId
methods.description: Checks if a specific key ID exists in the collection.

methods.name: AddKeyId
methods.description: Adds a new key ID to the collection or updates the system flags if it already exists.

methods.name: UpdateKeyStatus
methods.description: Updates the status of a given key ID, adding it if not present.

methods.name: IsSupported
methods.description: Checks if all requested keys are supported (present) in the collection.

methods.name: IsEmpty
methods.description: Checks if the key ID list is empty.

methods.name: Parse
methods.description: Parses the raw encryption data, extracting PSSH, XML, or JSON init data.

methods.name: ParsePSSHBox
methods.description: Parses a PSSH box from data, extracting key IDs and system types.

methods.name: ParseXMLBox
methods.description: Parses XML data for key IDs, supporting different header formats for DRM keys.

methods.name: ParseJSONInitData
methods.description: Parses JSON formatted init data containing key IDs.
